plugins.name: postproxy
plugins.description: Publish, schedule, and manage social media posts, comments, DMs, reviews, and Google Business profiles across 10+ platforms directly from Claude Code.

skills.name: analytics
skills.description: Show performance stats for a post or a social media profile. Use when the user asks about engagement, impressions, likes, or follower growth.

skills.name: comments
skills.description: Manage comments on posts published via Postproxy. Use when the user wants to list, reply to, hide, delete, or like comments on a post on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, or LinkedIn.

skills.name: dm
skills.description: Send and manage direct messages via Postproxy. Use when the user wants to read or send DMs, reply in a chat, react to a message, or privately reply to a comment on Facebook/Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, or Bluesky.

skills.name: google-business
skills.description: Manage a Google Business Profile via Postproxy. Use when the user wants to edit their Google business listing (name, description, hours, photos, attributes, services, food menus, action links) or read and reply to Google reviews.

skills.name: history
skills.description: Show recent social media post activity from Postproxy. Use when the user asks what was posted recently or wants to check post statuses.

skills.name: profiles
skills.description: List connected social media accounts in Postproxy. Use when the user asks which platforms are connected, wants to see their accounts or placements, or wants follower/engagement stats for a profile.

skills.name: publish
skills.description: Create and publish a social media post via Postproxy. Use when the user wants to post, schedule, queue, draft, edit, thread, or delete content across social media platforms.

skills.name: queues
skills.description: Manage Postproxy posting queues. Use when the user wants to list, create, update, pause, or delete recurring posting queues, or check a queue's next available slot.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Verify Postproxy connection and show connected social media profiles. Use on first install, when troubleshooting authentication, or when connecting a new social media account.

skills.name: summary
skills.description: Show an account activity summary via Postproxy. Use when the user asks "what's the status?", wants an overview of recent posting/engagement, or wants to know what comments, reviews, or DMs are awaiting a reply.
